strings: r_c0 makes sure that the nest is nice and soft, set aside for m_c to rest in once {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/recover/recovers} from {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} fainting spell.
When m_c blinks {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} eyes open, it's to worried Clanmates hovering around {PRONOUN/m_c/object}. It appears that m_c had fainted.
m_c wakes up in the middle of the forest, with little memory of what led to {PRONOUN/m_c/object} falling asleep there.
